clue.text: Politician well-chosen, a Tory maintains

indicators.note: maintains in the sense of holds within, so the phrase before it keeps the answer inside its letters

explanation.surface: A shrewdly picked Conservative is keeping a politician in place.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of a senate is a kind of politician, a legislator in an upper chamber.

clue.text: Brief description of July, we hear?

parts.note: something of July belongs to midsummer, so it is summery

explanation.definitionFit: A précis or short account of the main points is a brief description.

clue.text: Perhaps 1 mule ran off

explanation.definitionFit: The figure 1 is an example of a written number symbol.

clue.text: Sent out to wrap Ellie's first present, perhaps?

out in the sense of disordered, so the letters of the word before are rearranged

explanation.walkthrough: 'out' turns SENT into TNSE, which wraps round the E from 'Ellie's first'. The present tense is a grammatical example, hence 'perhaps'.
explanation.definitionFit: The present is one grammatical tense, alongside past and future, so it exemplifies the category.

clue.text: Relaxed, having trapped muscle — it's appreciated

pec is short for pectoral, a chest muscle

clue.text: Clutched top of glass, extremely drunk

parts.note: ripped is slang for very drunk

explanation.definitionFit: Gripped and clutched are synonyms, both meaning held tightly.

clue.text: Excellent Greek nosh

clue.text: Form fine clue about navy's power

form as a verb means shape the letters into a new arrangement

clue.text: Not all biased

definitions.meaning: ... also means favouring one side, prejudiced

clue.text: Most men ordered seconds

clue.text: Doctor offers to bandage first of the stabs

explanation.definitionFit: To have a stab at something is to attempt it, so stabs are attempts.

clue.text: A conservationist seizes me — time for sympathy

parts.note: a Green is an environmentalist or conservationist
taken as written

clue.text: Frames for carrying pails by the sound of it — they're yellow

clue.text: Lots keen to organise delays, ultimately — they hold us up

clue.text: Figures percussionist might have them

clue.text: Held up and dangled

clue.text: The key to clean locks?

clue.text: See a damaged Lowry initially put here?

clue.text: Sons watch someone hard to get rid of

clue.text: Passage from cellist ensures the audience does this?

clue.text: Fierce stare from large alien

parts.note: taken as written
ties are links or connections

clue.text: The woman starts to escape, running clear

clue.text: See red clump in SW river?

parts.note: a winkle is a small edible sea snail

clue.text: Appropriate time to wake up Queen

clue.text: Wants attractive house round heart of Seville
